records.value: Test the learned bounded soil-preparation method on one nearby forest-floor footprint, without disturbing the planted root or assuming the result will support cultivation.

value.summary: Provide a personally learnable method to assess and, where physically feasible, tend the existing planted root through a bounded cultivation experiment. Support persistent work, observation of actual outcomes, and harvesting only if real edible growth occurs.

candidates.function: Examine one nominated radius-0.2 footprint, then attempt at most two rounds of manual loose-cover displacement, conserving debris inside the original boundary.
Place owned moss, inspect the resulting arrangement or perform a real ground-supported contact/rest trial.
Prepare a small soil patch and place one real root unit for a persistent observation trial; resume or cancel unfinished work.
Physically examine one reachable x/y footprint and report visible surface evidence plus provisional compatibility with the existing root-placement operation.

execution.progress: Exact personal process ID, footprint, paid rounds, original cover and residues persist. Resume pays outstanding rounds only. Final/blocked attempts close their transient lock.

details.costs: Fresh start: one round and 0.5 energy for feasibility. Up to two additional work rounds cost one energy each. Radius is fixed at 0.2; x/y bind the job and cannot be substituted. No tool, root, water, food or inventory material is given or consumed.
details.effects: Supports explicitly modeled loose forest-floor cover only. Each supported footprint begins with finite 0.04 cover mass units, with hand capacity 0.02 per work round. All displaced matter remains non-food non-harvestable residue inside the boundary. Repeated attempts reuse actual remaining cover/residues, never reset quantities. Partial changes persist; cancel/death closes only the work lock, without restoration or refund. Entire-footprint root eligibility remains false while any cover or residue remains; exhausting work does not prove suitable soil. No unattended work, regrowth suppression, planting, food, moisture/fertility improvement or reward. Study and surface changes are separate.

packet.access: Omission is not absence. Query abilities, own inventory, knowledge, projects, memory, state or personally observed objects in batches. Search or exact ids; offset is a zero-based record offset, part selects a large record fragment. Queries expose no hidden properties, other private records or historical capabilities. Queries do not perform physical trials or award experience.
